QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Yorozu's Wrath and Tengu's Mercy
QuestInfo.0: You defeated 500 monsters but Yorozu hasn't agreed to be your friend.
QuestInfo.1: Yorozu asked you to defeat 999 monsters near your Level, but thankfully Tengu intervened.
QuestInfo.2: Yorozu became your friend! Hopefully that's something you still wanted.
